items.title: Smart and accessible dashboard
items.content: Visualize your agricultural data in real time. Our web platform and mobile app provide alerts, reports, and clear recommendations so any producer can make confident, evidence-based decisions.

items.title: Open 3D part designs
items.content: We repair, innovate, and share. Every physical AgroTico Smart part, from sensor supports to housings, has open 3D designs so anyone can print, improve, or adapt them to their needs.

items.title: Open and collaborative code
items.content: Transparency and continuous improvement. All AgroTico Smart software is open source, encouraging global collaboration and allowing universities, developers, and farming communities to adapt and optimize it freely.

items.title: Training and open knowledge
items.content: Technology only transforms when shared. We offer workshops, guides, and educational materials so producers, youth, and cooperatives can learn to use and maintain the system, promoting a more inclusive and sustainable agriculture.

items.question: What is AgroTico Smart and how does it help me?
items.answer: AgroTico Smart is a comprehensive precision agriculture platform that combines IoT sensors, artificial intelligence, and satellite data to deliver personalized recommendations for planting, irrigation, fertilization, and crop selection based on your field conditions.

items.question: What does the AgroTico Smart kit include?
items.answer: The kit includes all essential components: a Raspberry Pi processing unit, specialized sensors (BMP390, SCD30, LTR390, soil moisture), a GPS module, connectivity, software with two years of updates, three years of technical support, and in-person technical training.

items.question: How much does it cost and is financing available?
items.answer: The base kit costs $400 USD (~₡201,000), with possible subsidies of up to 30% for small producers and two-payment financing (50% upfront and 50% post-harvest). Cooperative microcredit programs are also available for terms up to 24 months.

items.question: Does it work without constant internet?
items.answer: Yes. The system processes data locally on the device and generates technical reports without requiring constant connectivity. Internet improves synchronization and alert delivery, but it's not required for basic operation.

items.question: What real benefits will I get?
items.answer: AgroTico Smart helps plan planting with confidence, optimize water resources (~30% savings), reduce climate-event losses (~20%), and increase crop yield by 15% to 25%. It also empowers farmers, women, and youth, while strengthening cooperatives and rural communities.

items.question: Who helps me if I have product issues?
items.answer: It includes three years of local technical support and in-person training. There are also local validation committees and certified technicians who can assist with installation, calibration, and maintenance.

items.question: Is AgroTico Smart suitable for all crops?
items.answer: Initially it focuses on high-value vegetables (lettuce, tomatoes, peppers) and common crops in the Chorotega and Huetar Norte regions. The system can adapt to other crops as more data is collected and predictive models are refined.

items.question: How do I install the system on my farm?
items.answer: Installation is simple and training is included. Our technical team guides you step by step: optimal sensor placement, system connection, initial setup, and first readings. The process takes approximately 2–3 hours.

items.question: Do I need advanced technical knowledge to use it?
items.answer: No. AgroTico Smart is designed to be intuitive and easy to use. The dashboard shows clear information with visual alerts and plain-language recommendations. The included training will prepare you to use all features.

items.question: What type of warranty does the product offer?
items.answer: We offer a one-year warranty on electronic components and three years of technical support. If a sensor fails, we replace it at no cost during the warranty period. We also provide free software updates.

items.question: Can I expand the system in the future?
items.answer: Absolutely! The system is modular and scalable. You can add more sensors, expand coverage to more areas of your farm, or integrate new features as your operation grows.

items.question: Is the project really open source?
items.answer: Yes, completely. All our code, 3D designs, and documentation are available on GitHub under open licenses. We believe in transparency and that technology should be accessible to everyone.
